arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Olson stated that Congress and state legislatures agree citizens need access to offender information.
Mr. Thompson argued the Alaska Act imposes punishment because it has three classic punitive features.
Mr. Roberts explained that the law makes truthful information available to help protect the public.
